title: VTC: define protocol gateway abstraction (PSTN/SIP/ITU)
description: JMAP VTC needs a clean interface to PSTN, SIP (RFC 3261+), and ITU-T VTC (H.323/H.324) without re-litigating every external verb. Design: (1) Replace VTCDialInNumber with a broader VTCGateway type advertising available protocol gateways and their capabilities. (2) Add gatewayMetadata opaque object on VTCParticipant for protocol-specific state. (3) Add dial-out operation for outbound gateway calls. (4) Define VTCGatewaySignal ephemeral event as a pass-through for protocol-specific signals (DTMF, SIP REFER, hold/resume, codec renegotiation) that don't map to core VTC lifecycle. The principle: lifecycle operations (join, leave, mute, kick, end) are first-class; everything else is opaque pass-through so external spec changes never require JMAP VTC amendments.
close_reason: Replaced VTCDialInNumber with VTCGateway abstraction covering PSTN/SIP/H.323. Added VTCDialInEntry, gatewayData on VTCParticipant, dial-out operation, VTCGatewaySignal ephemeral event for opaque protocol pass-through. Renamed dialInPin to gatewayPin. Updated security and non-prescriptions sections. External protocol verbs now flow through without requiring spec amendments.
